response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT a.translink, t.ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.peercorr > 0.149 AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), counts AS (SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM matched GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist) SELECT translink, ordertypedist, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction FROM counts ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10;
